hook_line: CANCER DRUGS GET A PRICE CAP

hook_stat.sub: Expected MRP fall on the most heavily marked-up cancer medicines

stats.label: Anti-cancer medicines with trade margins capped by the NPPA
New cap on trade margins as a share of MRP
Highest mark-up found on some medicines before the cap

diaspora_bullets: Families funding treatment in India should check the new MRP before paying
Hospitals and retailers must charge the revised prices from November 9
news_summary: The NPPA has capped trade margins at 30% of MRP on 137 anti-cancer medicines, with prices expected to fall by up to 70% on some medicines from November 9.
payoff: From November 9, hospitals and retailers must charge the revised prices.
